messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: MedixTech security posture + private deployment options — post-call follow-up

Hi Sanjay / Priya,

Thanks again for the productive call today — appreciate you walking through MedixTech’s primary security controls and the three deployment scenarios you’re evaluating (hosted, VPC/private, and air-gapped staging). I wanted to capture the ask list and propose immediate next steps so nothing slips through the cracks.

Recap / asks (action items for MedixTech in bold):
- SOC 2 status: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II in progress; please share the most recent report and any in-scope systems. (attachment preferred)
- Regulatory posture: confirm whether any workloads require HIPAA-level handling or are constrained by GDPR data residency/consent requirements.
- Vendor security questionnaire: you said you have a standard vendor form — if you can share the PDF or a link we’ll start filling it out.
- Network topology: please share a basic diagram (CIDR ranges, VPCs, on-prem segments) for the environment(s) you want us to assess.
- Air-gapped requirement: you flagged one environment that must be air-gapped — please confirm whether it must be physically isolated (no egress) or logically isolated with controlled sync windows.
- Technical constraints: any firewall/proxy appliances, strict egress rules, or hardware HSM requirements we should know about.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) MedixTech -> Share SOC2 doc + network diagram + vendor questionnaire (target: Mon 11/30).
2) Redwood -> Tech kickoff + design workshop with Dev and Hannah (30–45m). We can run a short workshop to map an architecture that meets your isolation and compliance needs. Proposed slots: Tue 12/1 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 12/2 09:00–09:45 PT.
3) Redwood -> Draft a concise comparison (VPC peering vs PrivateLink vs fully air-gapped) and a recommended starting point for a proof-of-concept.

Attached: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf (checklist for SOC/infra artifacts). I’ll follow up separately with a draft diagram after Dev and I sketch the recommended topology.

Thanks — looking forward to the docs so we can scope the work and put together the workshop materials.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Tessa — thanks for the follow-up and clear asks. Team, looping Priya (security lead) for details below.

Answers / attachments:
- SOC 2: attaching our in-progress SOC 2 Type II (medixtech-soc2-report-2026.pdf). It’s currently in the final audit phase; I don’t expect major scope changes but will confirm by EOD Mon.
- HIPAA/GDPR: We have PHI in a discrete dataset for two workflows so HIPAA applicability is limited to that environment. GDPR/data residency: primary EU customers’ data is stored in eu-central; other data is in us-west.
- Vendor questionnaire: linking the PDF here and attaching our network sketch (medixtech-network-diagram.png). We’ve started the questionnaire but haven’t completed the technical appendix.
- Air-gapped env: the staging cluster for clinical modeling is required to have no inbound egress except approved artifact syncs scheduled by the infra team (effectively physically isolated from public endpoints).

Attached: medixtech-soc2-report-2026.pdf (application/pdf), medixtech-network-diagram.png (image/png)

We’d appreciate Redwood’s suggested topology for the air-gapped option and the minimal trust boundary for the VPC option. Happy to run the workshop — Tue 12/1 10:00 PT works for me.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao

Hi Sanjay / Priya — quick technical clarifications before the workshop so we can tailor the deck: 

1) EKS vs self-managed / bare-metal: the diagram shows an EKS cluster. For an air-gapped environment we typically recommend a minimal, self-contained runtime; can you confirm if EKS is allowed in your air-gapped staging, or whether the cluster will be a self-hosted K8s instance on isolated hardware?

2) CIDR ranges & overlapping networks: please send the CIDR blocks for the VPC(s) you plan to use. If you have existing peering with cloud partner networks, list those (we need to avoid IP overlap).

3) Required ingress/egress: list any outbound endpoints that must remain reachable (artifact storage, SSO, telemetry sinks). For strict air-gapped, we assume no outbound access except via an approved pull window and signed artifacts.

4) HSM/KMS: do you have a customer-managed KMS or HSM in the air-gapped env? If so, what vendor/model and how will keys be injected?

If you can reply to these or upload them to the shared folder before Tue 12/1 09:00 PT it’ll help us draft concrete diagrams. I’ll prepare two candidate designs: (A) VPC-isolated with PrivateLink + egress gateway, (B) fully air-gapped with periodic signed artifact sync.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
